title: The Cohen–Lenstra Heuristics
statement_plain: As K ranges over imaginary (or real) quadratic number fields ordered by discriminant, the odd part of the ideal class group Cl(K) is conjectured to be distributed like a random finite abelian group G weighted inversely by |Aut(G)| (for imaginary quadratic fields, u = 0) or by |G| * |Aut(G)| (for real quadratic fields, u = 1).
